“on opposite sides” renders a repeated “on its two sides.”
“near the ark” renders “over the ark”; “over the ark of the testimony” renders “over the testimony.”
“every morning” renders “morning by morning,” and “trims” renders “makes good.”
“trims” renders “sets up,” “at twilight” renders “between the evenings,” and “perpetual incense” renders “incense of continuity.”
“take a census” renders “take the sum (head),” and “a ransom for himself” renders “a ransom of his life (nefesh).”
